description: This Java class `LayoutAnimationsByDefault` demonstrates the use of the `animateLayoutChanges` attribute in XML to animate addition and removal of views within a `GridLayout`. It adds a button to dynamically insert new buttons into the grid, each with a click listener to remove itself, showcasing layout transition animations.

classes.name: LayoutAnimationsByDefault
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating layout change animations within a GridLayout by dynamically adding and removing Buttons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up the button click listener for adding new buttons.
